text:
samir: FYI planning runtime 2.22 rollforward at 23:30 UTC. Kernel reorder + kv-cache pointer fix. Need pin guidance for longseq-* models.

vesna: Canary showed p95 +10% for longseq-quant on small batches; no OOMs but warmup slower. Attaching minimal repro in PR.

kyle: Proposal: soft-pin longseq-* -> 2.21 for 6h post-roll. Let other groups move to 2.22.

ops-oncall: Set deadman revert at 03:30 UTC. Auto-revert if 5xx > 1.5% or p95 increase > 25% sustained 10m. Page leads if triggered.

deploybot: Automated: snapshotting pinlist at 23:00 UTC. Preview diff:
```
- runtime_pin: 2.21 -> models: [safety-filter/*]
+ runtime_pin: 2.22 -> models: [fast-sampler/*]
+ soft_pin: longseq-* -> runtime:2.21 until 05:30 UTC
```

samir: Decision: apply soft_pin for longseq-* only. Action items:
- vesna: paste canary repro + short prompt by 23:10.
- kyle: update release notes to mention SDK 3.6 fallback support and quick rollback snippet by 23:15.
- deploybot: apply soft_pin at 23:00 and publish diff to /releases/2.22/pins.
- ops-oncall: enable deadman revert at 03:30 UTC.

docs-bot: Suggest adding a short note in release notes: "If you rely on long-context quantized models, consider setting runtime_preference: [\"2.22\", \"2.21\"] to allow graceful fallback."

vesna: Repro prompt: `summarize(very_long_doc, chunk=2048)` shows first-chunk latency spike. Flame graphs attached to PR.

kyle: Rollback snippet for notes:
```
# if regressions observed
# set client preference to fallback
runtime_preference: [\"2.21\"]
```

deploybot: Confirmed: soft_pin applied at 23:00 UTC. Pin diff published. Rollforward scheduled 23:30 UTC.

ops-oncall: Running embed/longseq smoke tests post-roll. Will page if thresholds breached.

samir: If any correctness regressions surface in canary, paste examples here and tag me. We'll hold further unpins until 08:00 UTC.

vesna: Follow-up: traced kv_refresh hot path at batch_size=1. Not blocking immediate roll but logging a follow-up ticket.

deploybot: Automated: rollforward started 23:30 UTC. Will post success/failure updates to #release-ops
